fixed: Free-text entry now reads a dancer followed by a move's name, such as `neighbor pass by` or `ones arch and dive`, as that move with those dancers, and a move's name with a full stop, comma or exclamation mark after it, such as `hey.`, instead of keeping them as custom figures. A move that does not take dancers that way (`hey`) with a dancer in front of it, and any line with an unrecognized word in the dancer's place, is still kept as a custom figure.

changed: `parseFreeTextFigureEntry`'s typed-name lookup (`typed_figure_names.dart`) ignores punctuation at the end of the line and reads one of `ones`, `twos`, `partner(s)`, `neighbor(s)`, `everyone`, `role1s` or `role2s` followed by a move name as that move with `who` set, when the move has a `who` param the taxonomy accepts; discouraged role words in the dancer's place are read by their meaning through the existing retries (`figureFromTypedDancerName`). Imports and the custom-figure re-parse are unchanged. Two corpus golden rows move, both free-text only: `Partner gate` and `Men give-and-take` now read as `gate` and `give_and_take`.
